mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_user b WHERE ) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product) AS products, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS orders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount),0) FROM `order` o WHERE ) AS completedAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status=0) AS pendingProducts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` o WHERE (o.order_status=5 OR )) AS refundOrders

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_user b WHERE AND b.create_time >= #{start} AND b.create_time < #{end}) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end}) AS products, COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN quantity ELSE 0 END),0) AS completedQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS completedAmount FROM `order` o WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end}

SELECT date, SUM(users) AS users, SUM(products) AS products, SUM(orders) AS orders FROM ( SELECT DATE(b.create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS users, 0 AS products, 0 AS orders FROM base_user b WHERE AND b.create_time >= #{start} AND b.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(b.create_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(create_time),0,COUNT(*),0 FROM product WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(create_time),0,0,COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) activity GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT id,name,SUM(products) AS products,SUM(completedOrders) AS completedOrders, SUM(completedQuantity) AS completedQuantity,SUM(completedAmount) AS completedAmount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(c.id,0) AS id,COALESCE(c.name,'未分类 / 商品已删除') AS name, COUNT(*) AS products,0 AS completedOrders,0 AS completedQuantity,0 AS completedAmount FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id=c.id WHERE p.create_time >= #{start} AND p.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.id,c.name UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(c.id,0),COALESCE(c.name,'未分类 / 商品已删除'),0,COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity),0),COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount),0) FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id=c.id WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND GROUP BY c.id,c.name ) category_activity GROUP BY id,name ORDER BY completedQuantity DESC,products DESC,id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN THEN 5 ELSE COALESCE(CAST(o.order_status AS SIGNED),-1) END AS status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM `order` o WHERE o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligibleUsers, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `order` o WHERE o.buyer_id=b.id AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end})),0) AS buyers, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product p WHERE p.user_id=b.id AND p.create_time >= #{start} AND p.create_time < #{end})),0) AS publishers FROM base_user b WHERE AND b.create_time < #{end}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE status=1 AND rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end}) AS visibleReviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review WHERE status=1 AND rating BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end}) AS positiveReviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` o WHERE AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_review r WHERE r.order_id=o.id AND r.status=1 AND r.rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)) AS reviewedCompletedOrders
